comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
To be precise, this box is a one-time per char/toon reward for talking to the Priest in the Temple of Poseidon located in the Acropolis of Atlantis -- access to which is conditional on completing a quest chain, and whether or not Atlantis is actually in the game server (it leaves on August 1st and no one can say if or when it will return, though on JP servers it did reappear/redisappear).

The box gives awards randomly and in addition to the above items, it can also drop:

Protos Rouxa / Protos Rouxa | +1 Alchemy/Seasoning trading, male/female only
Veil of Dominions (no-trade) x10
Thunder God's charm (no-trade) x10
Wind King's Pendant (no-trade) x10
Silver tarot x5
Mysterious Gold x5
Orichalcum x1

Speaking of vanishing, I think it's about time I do the same. Cheers, and great online voyaging to you.
